title: STOP Health Threats Act
latestAction: Referred to the Subcommittee on Economic Development, Public Buildings, and Emergency Management.
summary:
Safety Training for Officers on Public Health Threats Act or the STOP Health Threats Act

This bill directs the Department of Health and Human Services to award grants to local governments for the training of local enforcement officers on the public health threats resulting from building code violations.
